label: IamTheLime verifies with get_screenshot before declaring anything finished; Flow Mode agrees in prose but does not make the screenshot a named pre-declaration gate.
FigJam forbids page creation from a plugin but boards can hold several pages selectable via figma.setCurrentPageAsync, refining iteration 1's page finding.
One numbered section per concept, with page.children containing exactly one section, is a creation-free replacement for Flow Mode's page-based rollback unit.
The palette is one accent family, not one hex: MAIN plus note and warning roles, which Flow Mode's distinct-hex accent count would wrongly reject.
Text belongs in separate text nodes, never in a shape's built-in text; this is only actionable on the fj/use_figma route because generate_diagram owns node text.
IamTheLime's shape vocabulary is SQUARE, DIAMOND and information-bearing dashed borders, with no stadium or merge-dot circle; wholesale adoption would delete two of Flow Mode's four shapes.
Deleting a node silently deletes its connectors, so connector re-listing must follow any deletion; official fileKey replacement warns of no such cascade.
Connector labels sit at the line midpoint with no offset control and collide with boxes, a geometric reason for short labels that outlives the generator-specific reason.
IamTheLime gives concrete board spacing numbers (20-24px padding, 30px box gaps, 120-160px bands, 60px section padding) that Flow Mode cannot use on the generator-owned hosted route.
Read-back needs a bounded inspection strategy: whole-page get_figjam can overflow, get_metadata is design-only, and get_screenshot needs a real nodeId.
connectorEndStrokeCap variants distinguish decision branches without colour, giving a greyscale-safe alternative to Flow Mode's single accent on the fj route.
figma.createTable is the correct primitive for genuinely tabular content; Flow Mode has no comparison-table pattern and its shape rule would force a shape grid.

direction: Adopting IamTheLime's SQUARE/DIAMOND/dashed shape list as Flow Mode's vocabulary
reason: It removes stadium start/end and the merge-dot circle without replacing their semantics.
